title: 第26章 玉凝的秘密
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
玉凝的怀里没有抱孩子。

    陆沉张了张嘴，还没来得及说话，就看见玉凝绕过桌子，走到门边。她看了他一眼，伸手把洞府的大门关上了。

    然后她抬起手，指尖泛起点点灵光，在门扉上轻轻一抹。

    一层透明的结界无声无息地蔓延开来，将整个洞府笼罩其中。

    陆沉的瞳孔骤然收缩。

    那灵光凝而不散，灵力浑厚绵长，结界布得行云流水，一气呵成，这绝不是筑基修士能做到的事！

    “你……你不是筑基中期？”

    玉凝转过身看着他。那双杏眼里没有慌张，没有闪躲，只有一种平静到近乎冷淡的坦然。

    “金丹圆满，成亲之前就已经是了。”

    陆沉感觉自己的脑子嗡了一声。

    “为什么要瞒着？”

    “因为我不想让他知道，我比他强得多。”玉凝的声音很平静。

    “我不想遮掩他的光芒，所以他不知道我比他强，不知道他娶了一个境界比他高的人，他什么都不知道。”

    她走近一步，仰头看着陆沉的脸。

    “就像他不知道……宝儿不是他的一样。”

    陆沉后退了一步，背抵住了门。

    “你在说什么胡话……”

    “师兄，你还要装到什么时候？”

    陆沉的心跳漏了一拍。

    玉凝没有逼他，只是站在那里，静静地看着他。那双杏眼里没有质问，没有愤怒，只有一种看透一切的笃定。

    “你的鼻子。”

    陆沉下意识摸了一下自己的鼻子。

    “宝儿的鼻子和你一模一样。我见过很多人，从来没有见过那种形状。除了你和宝儿。”

    陆沉的手僵在空中。

    “还有那天在饭桌上，王师兄说他的事，你的脸色一下子就变了。别人没注意到，我注意到了。你在发抖。”

    “还有那次见到师娘……”

    她一步步走近，每一步都不急不缓，像是早就排练过无数遍。
content_en:
There was no child in Yu Ning's arms.

Lu Chen opened his mouth, but before he could speak, he saw Yu Ning walking around the table and walking to the door.She glanced at him and reached out to close the door of the cave.

Then she raised her hand, her fingertips glowing with light, and lightly touched the door.

A transparent barrier spread silently, covering the entire cave.

Lu Chen's pupils suddenly shrank.

The spiritual light is condensed and never disperses, the spiritual power is thick and long, and the barrier is spread out smoothly, all in one go. This is definitely not something that a foundation-building monk can do!

"You...you're not in the middle stage of foundation building?"

Yu Ning turned around and looked at him.There was no panic or dodge in those almond-shaped eyes, only a calmness that was almost cold.

"The golden elixir is perfect, it was already there before we got married."

Lu Chen felt his head buzzing.

"Why hide it?"

"Because I don't want him to know that I am much better than him." Yu Ning's voice was calm.

"I don't want to cover up his light, so he doesn't know that I'm better than him. He doesn't know that he married someone who is higher than him. He doesn't know anything."

She took a step closer and looked up at Lu Shen's face.

"It's like he doesn't know... Bao'er is not his."

Lu Chen took a step back and pressed his back against the door.

"What nonsense are you talking about..."

"Senior brother, how long will you continue to pretend?"

Lu Chen's heart skipped a beat.

Yu Ning didn't force him, she just stood there and looked at him quietly.There was no questioning or anger in those almond-shaped eyes, only a determination that saw through everything.

"Your nose."

Lu Chen subconsciously touched his nose.

"Bao'er's nose is exactly the same as yours. I've seen many people, but I've never seen that shape. Except for you and Bao'er."

Lu Chen's hands froze in the air.

"And that day at the dinner table, when Senior Brother Wang said something about him, your expression suddenly changed. Others didn't notice it, but I did. You were shaking."

"And that time I met the master's wife..."

She walked closer step by step, each step unhurried, as if she had rehearsed it countless times.
